ProcedureGrade A

Commission prepares an information item for the December Council

ST 15799/26 concerns the Justice and Home Affairs Council meeting on 3–4 December and is titled as an update on the application of the Schengen acquis in Cyprus. It is listed under Any Other Business. Access to the text is restricted.

Technical readinessGrade A / C

Tender opens for passport-control booths in Larnaca and Paphos

Tender MTCW/AIR2/BOOTHS/2026 was published with an estimated value of €440,000 and a 21 December submission deadline. Philenews reported 22 booths and eight months for manufacture, installation and testing after contract signature. The procurement entry gives an overall contract duration of 20 months.

PoliticsGrade B

EU and UK reaffirm work on the bases protocol

The summit's joint statement committed to completing implementation of the protocol on the British Sovereign Base Areas in Cyprus in all its parts.

Meeting page

Cyprus and Schengen: key questions

Is Cyprus in Schengen now?

As of 27 November 2026, accession is still in progress. The European Commission says Cyprus participates in Schengen cooperation, but the EU Council has not yet abolished internal border checks.

Status on the Commission website

When could Cyprus join Schengen?

The monitor’s working forecast is 2027. The 1 July target reflects Greece’s political position; an adopted date must be distinguished from statements and forecasts. The forecast page explains the conditions and possible delays.
